title: Browserborn update: rare and epic monsters now feed a second XP bar for the passive tree
author: Ditex_Design
selftext:
Quick update on Browserborn, the Chrome extension that spawns monsters on the pages you browse.

Monsters come in three variants. Normal ones are most of what you see. Rare ones glow blue and show up about 12% of the time, epic ones glow purple-gold at about 3%. They hit a bit harder and pay out 2.25× and 5× the XP and gold.

The new part is that they also fill a separate Skill XP bar. A rare kill gives 10, an epic gives 30, a normal gives nothing. Fill the bar and you get a bonus skill point for your class's 40-node passive tree, on top of the one you get per level. The first point costs 50, and each one after costs 10 more.

So when something glowing shows up on a page, it's worth stopping for. The video shows the whole loop.

comments.author: Ditex_Design
comments.body: A few details that didn't fit in the video: there are 6 classes, each with its own 40-node tree and two keystones. The run of unlocks at the end of the video is sped up; one kill doesn't equal one node. The monster art is AI-generated, and there's a toggle that swaps all of it for code-drawn sigils if you'd rather not see it.
